testPolicy.text: CDS C8A for students applying for fall 2027: SAT or ACT required to be considered for admission; UF also accepts the CLT. Official test score deadline for the 2026-27 cycle is October 22 (ED), November 8 (EA) and January 22 (RD).
testPolicy.since: Florida Board of Governors regulation 6.002 requires a test score for State University System first-year admission

cost.totalIncludes: Incoming freshmen, on or off campus, 30 credit hours: tuition and fees (projected) + books, course materials, supplies, equipment + transportation + living expenses + miscellaneous personal + federal student loan fees 56.

inState.note: financial aid page gives tuition/fees 6,440 combined; split 4,477 + 1,959 from CDS G1 (which totals 6,436)

outOfState.note: financial aid page gives tuition/fees 34,620 combined; split from CDS G1 (which totals 34,616)

aidPromise.text: Machen Florida Opportunity Scholarship: a full grant and scholarship package, up to financial need, for low-income first-generation first-year students; since 2022-23 parents' combined income must be below $55,000 and assets below $35,000.

deadlines.early: October 15 (Early Decision, binding, decision December 11, 2026) or November 1 (Early Action, non-binding, decision January 22)

facts.text: UF admitted 9,387 of 42,172 Florida applicants and 8,086 of 39,420 out-of-state applicants for fall 2025, but 5,856 of the 7,619 enrolled first-years were Floridians.
UF now offers binding Early Decision: apply through the Common App by October 15, 2026, decision by December 11, 2026.
The waiting list is close to a dead end: 2,737 students accepted a place for fall 2025 and 1 was admitted.
A Florida resident's 2026-27 budget is 25,830 against 54,010 for an out-of-state student; tuition and fees are 6,440 versus 34,620.
Low-income first-generation students whose parents earn under $55,000 can receive a full grant package through the Machen Florida Opportunity Scholarship.

notes: Cycle from CDS 2025-26 C1 (40,876 + 49,647 = 90,523 applied; 8,725 + 9,678 = 18,403 admitted; 3,526 + 4,093 = 7,619 enrolled). Residency table: the international column is printed shifted in the PDF (8,931 applied appears under 'Unknown'); the three columns sum exactly to the C1 totals. C21 lists ED closing 10/15/2026 and notification 12/11/2026 (next cycle); C22 EA 11/1, notification 1/23 (fall 2025 cycle; the 2026-27 chart says January 22). Test policy page not opened separately: CDS C8A and the deadlines page (official test score deadline) are used. CDS G1 vs aid page differ by 4 dollars. No official fall 2026 class numbers recorded.
